mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Status = 1) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE Status = 1) AS courses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories WHERE Status = 1) AS categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM userlearns WHERE Status = 1) AS learns, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions WHERE Status = 1) AS questions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages) AS messages

SELECT CUID, CID, CourseName, CourseImage, Teacher, LearnTime, Clicked, Orders, Recommend, Status, CreateTime, CourseExplain FROM courses WHERE Status = 1 ORDER BY Clicked DESC, CUID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE(StartTime) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM userlearns WHERE Status = 1 AND StartTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(StartTime) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT c.CID AS cid, c.CategoryName AS categoryName, COUNT(co.CUID) AS courseCount FROM categories c LEFT JOIN courses co ON c.CID = co.CID AND co.Status = 1 WHERE c.Status = 1 GROUP BY c.CID, c.CategoryName ORDER BY c.Orders, c.CID
